dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Haha! Our old enemy's gone all quiet now.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Our long battle with the Abyss has been like an extreme sport marathon, but there's nothing that the Scions of the Canopy can't overcome.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Like with cliff-jumping, some come straight back up, others land safely, and still others fly off to yet farther places.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Every outcome has a value of its own, and thus, deserves to be remembered.
